scripts.test:rules: node scripts/prepare-rules.mjs --emulator && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-galpi --only auth,firestore,storage 'vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts'
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/prepare-rules.mjs --emulator && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-galpi --only auth,firestore,storage 'playwright test'
scripts.emulators: node scripts/prepare-rules.mjs --emulator && firebase emulators:start --project demo-galpi --only auth,firestore,storage
scripts.deploy: npm run prepare:rules && npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules,storage
